```{r}
rm(list=ls())
library(pacman)
p_load(tidyverse, dplyr, modelsummary, gt)
```

```{r}
total <- read_csv('../data/total.csv')
total
```

```{r}


total_sum <- total %>%
  transmute(
    `Annual Visitation` = Year_vis,
    `Total Spending` = tot_spend_adj,
    `Jobs` = jobs,
    `Labor Income` = labor_inc_adj,
    `Value Added` = val_add_adj,
    `Economic Output` = econ_output_adj
  )

table_gt <- datasummary(
  `Annual Visitation` +
    `Total Spending` +
    `Jobs` +
    `Labor Income` +
    `Value Added` +
    `Economic Output` ~
    N + Mean + SD + Min + Median + Max,
  data = total_sum,
  fmt = 2,
  notes = "Note: All dollar values are reported in thousands of 2024 dollars ($000s) and have been adjusted for inflation using the annual-average CPI-U.",
  output = "gt"
)

```


```{r}
png_url <- "https://i.pinimg.com/736x/98/96/64/98966408bc79f612faf1edb2174a4afd.jpg"

table_gt <- table_gt %>%
  opt_css(
    css = paste0(
      "
      table.gt_table {
        background-image: url('", png_url, "');
        background-size: cover;
        background-repeat: no-repeat;
        background-position: center;
      }

      table.gt_table th,
      table.gt_table td,
      table.gt_table .gt_heading,
      table.gt_table .gt_sourcenote {
        background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25) !important;
      }
      "
    )
  )

table_gt

```
```{r}
total %>%
  filter(Park == "ACAD") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=Year, y=tot_spend)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point()

total %>%
  filter(Park == "ACAD") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=Year, y=Year_vis)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point()
```


```{r}
## CREATING TREATMENT TIME
total_annual <- total[, -c(2:13)] # annual data only
#write.csv(total_annual, "../data/total_yr.csv", row.names = FALSE)
 
did_data <- total_annual %>%
  filter(is.na(start_year) | start_year >= 2012) %>% #removing parks that were treated before 2012 
  mutate(
    cohort = if_else(
      !is.na(start_year) & start_year <= max(Year),
      as.integer(start_year),
      0L
    )
  )
```

```{r}
total$did <- total$Year * total$treat

didreg = lm(Year_vis ~ treat + Year + did, data = total)
summary(didreg)
```
